newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close higher after volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close higher after volatile trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended a bit higher on Thursday after swinging between positive and negative zones.
Shares in some blue-chip firms continued to firm, but overall gains were limited by the financial sector, which has been dragged down since the end of last year.
The Nikkei 225 average finished up 51.21 points or 0.28 percent at 18,144.34. It ranged from 17,970.85 to 18,317.63.
Its March futures gained 110 points to 18,120.
"It was a tug of war between bullish and bearish sectors, as the rebound earlier this week was feeble," said Kenichi Sagami, general manager at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
